reviews.review: Honestly disappointed, the demo felt good and I wanted more, but man this game needs more time in the oven. Unless I'm insane, frame gen is on by default for some reason and I could not find the option to turn this off, I cannot stand it, fake frame ghosting causing motion sickness. On medium settings, this also makes my rig scream louder than 90% of games I play. If levels have the heavy rain modifier, there's artifacting all over the place. On every single level I played, I had to use the "stuck leaf" menu option at least once. Some menus close when hitting escape, some do not. The tool wheel gets stuck open and forces you to quit to clear it. Geometry lazily sticking through a lot of terrain. I also thought it was a weird focus to have controller support and multiple camera angles in a game that needs performance optimization the most. Honestly better if avoided until most of these critical issues are addressed.
